decisions.reason: The Magento template is directly tied to the firm's shop-hosting segment and has low upkeep, so it remains a valuable option while demand is still uncertain.
The generic responsive template lacks a dedicated page and strategic fit with the firm's agency-focused hosting and tools, and after a year its value appears unlikely to materialize.
Premium support aligns with the firm's core service promise and can be kept as an option despite ongoing staffing costs.
The version management tool has its own page and supports the firm's developer-focused tools, so it is a low-cost, promising option worth keeping.
The data processing contract tool has its own page and addresses a clear compliance need, so its option value remains high and it is kept.
